newsitem.title: INDIA: India M3 money supply eases to 16.1 pct on Apr 25.
newsitem.headline: India M3 money supply eases to 16.1 pct on Apr 25.

text.p: India's year-on-year M3 money supply growth was 16.1 percent on April 25, 1997, down from 16.6 percent the previous fortnight, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said in its weekly statistical supplement on Saturday.
M3 MONEY SUPPLY GROWTH (yr-on-yr in pct)
Money supply was 7,111.78 billion rupees on April 25, 1997 against 7,107.83 billion rupees on April 11, 1997 and compared to 6,123.94 billion on April 26, 1996, the RBI said.
